Labyrinten. Musa skal fram til osten ned: The maze. The mouse is going to the cheese in the bottom right corner.
There's a hedge in the way.
The dots show part of the way.
Musa 🐭🧀 Jeg fant osten i en {hva} på {ti: Squeak 🐭🧀 I found the cheese in a {hva} in {tid}! Can you?
Musa er sulten! Hjelp den gjennom labyri: The mouse is hungry! Help it through the maze to the cheese in the corner.
Sveip den veien musa skal gå, eller tryk: Swipe the way the mouse should go, or tap the arrows. You can also drag the mouse with your finger.
Musa løper til neste kryss: The mouse runs to the next turning
Ett sveip, og musa løper gjennom gangen: One swipe and the mouse runs along the path until it has to choose a way.
Kommer du til en blindvei, går du bare t: Hit a dead end? Just go back. The dots show the way you have been.
Står du fast? Trykk «Vis veien», så vise: Stuck? Tap ‘Show the way’ and the dots show part of the way.
Med tastatur: piltastene eller W, A, S o: On a keyboard: the arrow keys or W, A, S and D.
Hver labyrint er ny – og det finnes allt: Every maze is new – and there is always exactly one way to the cheese.
Begynn med en liten labyrint, og prøv en: Start with a small maze, and try a bigger one when it feels easy.
Help the mouse through the maze.
Første gang på denne størrelsen – nå har: First time at this size – now you have a record to beat!
